correctness.rationale: A direct decomposition yields three mutually orthogonal tangent leakage blocks; singular-vector rank-one input attains the exact realized norm. Orthogonal invariance and independent sketches yield the scalar factorization. Gaussian independent blocks reduce to inverse Wishart with finite second inverse moment iff ell>r+1. Haar row projector identity yields AA^T=W^-1-I and a Gaussian-frame trace formula; positive codimension produces divergence at ell<=r+1. The proof covers all admissible finite dimensions, fixed nonzero normal blocks and mixed ensembles, while CHECK.py corroborates identities without replacing analytic proofs.

value.rationale: Quantifies a natural stability/error observable of a newly studied oblique low-rank tangent projector. It gives exact finite vs infinite expected error boundaries, sharp realized worst-case amplification and a finite-population Haar regularization contrast, including a two-by-two case where full Gaussian sampling still has infinite mean-square error but Haar sampling has none. This is meaningful for sketch-size and distribution design while not asserting unproved runtime or trajectory improvements.
